cut_rhythm.pattern: Four long designed scenes, hard cuts at 3.17 / 4.83 / 8.87 s; every scene is one continuous 3D / UI motion-graphic world with its own internal animation (typed captions, camera spin). Slow-fast-slow: two short scenes (3.17 s, 1.67 s) then a 4.03 s spin scene, then one 14.6 s calm cream scene to the end card.

shots.camera_angle: Graphic / design-world: phone seen from above and tilted (0-3.2 s), flat-on UI cards with tilted 3D perspective (3.2-4.8 s), spinning interior of a phone-shaped room with the camera inside (4.8-8.9 s), flat-on cream poster layout (8.9-23.5 s).
shots.composition: Centred vertical stacks. Dark scenes: object top-centre (eye, phones), caption block lower-centre. Cream scenes: barcode top, caption mid-upper, search bar, statue head lower half; caption small and centred in empty space at 16-21 s.

moves: pull-out + pan left with spinning 3D rotation (scene 3)

elements.easing: ease-out / spring settle for cards and typed text; fast spinning with motion blur in scene 3

motion.speed_ramps: none detected; scene-3 spin shows heavy motion blur (judged from frames 5.4, 6.8)

text.role: kinetic captions that mirror the voice word-for-word (typed in a search bar, word-by-word reveal, highlighted key phrase)
text.weight: bold for key words, light/regular for connectors; italic bold used for the hook line
text.case: sentence case, Title Case on highlighted phrase ('Another Creator's', 'It Goes')
text.position: centre, mid-frame; hook block at 55-82% height
text.size_class: small connector words + large emphasised words (size contrast about 1:3)
text.animation_in: letter-by-letter typing in a search field (3.4-4.6 s); word reveal with highlight box wipe (6.8 s); blinking caret box around 'Ask Why it never' (8.3 s); word swap

grade.look: Scene 1-2: near-black bottle-green background with white type, one orange asterisk accent (about #E8704F). Scene 3-4: warm cream / off-white (#EBE8DB) with black type, green (#266047) and mint accents plus orange-red accent. Flat, clean, graphic; no film grade.

layout.safe_zones: Hook caption (2.7 s) sits at about 82% height, inside the bottom 35% unsafe zone; most later captions sit at 20-55% height, inside the safe area.
layout.framing_notes: Whole frame is the already-cropped inner edited video (screen-in-scene reel; monitor, room and desk ignored). Dark intro -> light body is a deliberate contrast flip at 4.83 s.

recipe.notes: Needs 3D phone-room scene (three.js / Remotion ThreeCanvas), search-bar typing component, stacked cards with perspective, highlight-box word reveal, barcode + orange asterisk line-draw (12.3 s), marble statue cut-out with bounding-box overlay. Fonts and easing not recoverable: best candidates only.
